bead.panel.chat-tab-chat: AI sidebar: tab that shows the current conversation.
bead.panel.chat-tab-chats: AI sidebar: tab that lists saved conversations to resume.
bead.panel.chat-tab-settings: AI sidebar: accessible name of the settings tab (icon only).
bead.panel.chat-title: AI sidebar: heading of the panel and the name shown above every assistant message.
bead.panel.chat-too-long: AI sidebar: error shown when the typed message exceeds the maximum the assistant accepts.
bead.panel.chat-unavailable: AI sidebar: error shown when the daemon does not offer the assistant methods.
bead.panel.chat-workspace: AI sidebar: button that moves the conversation to a workspace window.
bead.panel.chat-you: AI sidebar: label above the user's own messages in the transcript.
bead.panel.chat-your-answer: AI sidebar: hint inside the free-text answer box of an approval or question card.
bead.panel.connection-controls-unavailab: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): detail line: connecting and disconnecting is not possible from here right now.
bead.panel.network-auth-required: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message after connecting needed a password that was not given.
bead.panel.network-busy: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the network service is busy.
bead.panel.network-change-failed: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message after connecting or disconnecting failed.
bead.panel.network-connect: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): action word at the end of a network row; starts the connection.
bead.panel.network-connecting: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): action word on a network row while connecting.
bead.panel.network-control-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: network control is not available right now.
bead.panel.network-disconnect: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): action word at the end of a network row; ends the connection.
bead.panel.network-disconnecting: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): action word on a network row while disconnecting.
bead.panel.network-hidden: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): name used for a Wi-Fi network that does not broadcast its name.
bead.panel.network-list-changed: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the list of networks changed before the action was sent.
bead.panel.network-list-changed-retry: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the list changed; the user should repeat the action.
bead.panel.network-not-permitted: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the system refused the network change.
bead.panel.network-rejected: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the network request was invalid.
bead.panel.network-retry: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): action word on a network row after a failed password prompt.
bead.panel.network-timed-out: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message: the network change took too long.
bead.panel.network-title: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): heading of the network view.
bead.panel.network-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): primary line of the network view without data.
bead.panel.session-confirm-logout: Session menu: inline label the Log out item turns into while it waits for a second Enter or click; reverts after a few seconds. Also its accessible name.
bead.panel.session-confirm-reboot: Session menu: inline label the Restart item turns into while it waits for a second Enter or click; reverts after a few seconds. Also its accessible name.
bead.panel.session-confirm-shutdown: Session menu: inline label the Power off item turns into while it waits for a second Enter or click; reverts after a few seconds. Also its accessible name.
bead.panel.session-failed: Session menu: generic error when a log out, suspend, restart or power off request failed.
bead.panel.session-lock: Session menu entry: lock the screen.
bead.panel.session-lock-failed: Session menu: error shown when the daemon did not confirm that the screen is locked. Tell the user to lock it some other way.
bead.panel.session-logout: Session menu entry: end the current login session.
bead.panel.session-reboot: Session menu entry: restart the computer.
bead.panel.session-shutdown: Session menu entry: shut the computer down.
bead.panel.session-suspend: Session menu entry: suspend the computer to RAM.
bead.panel.session-unavailable: Session menu: error shown when the desktop daemon does not offer session control right now.
bead.panel.signal-strength: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): detail line: Wi-Fi signal strength in percent.
bead.panel.sound-close: Accessible name of the close button of the sound output panel.
bead.panel.sound-hint: Hint under the volume slider: it can be dragged or changed with the arrow keys.
bead.panel.sound-mute: Accessible name of the button that mutes or unmutes the sound output.
bead.panel.sound-title: Title of the sound output panel (also the heading of the audio status view).
bead.panel.sound-volume: Accessible name of the output volume slider.
bead.panel.status-data-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line: the desktop daemon has not delivered this status.
bead.panel.status-heading: Status panel: placeholder heading before the view knows which device it shows.
bead.panel.status-none: Status panel: placeholder primary line before any status arrives.
bead.panel.status-stale: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line: the shown status is the last one received and may be out of date.
bead.panel.status-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): primary line when the data of a view is missing; {name} is the translated view name (Network, Bluetooth, Battery, Sound output).
bead.panel.tray-close: Accessible name of the button that closes a system tray menu.
bead.panel.tray-empty: Shown in a system tray menu that has no entries.
bead.panel.wifi: Label of the Wi-Fi power row. Product name Wi-Fi is normally kept as is.
bead.panel.wifi-change-failed: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch after switching the radio failed.
bead.panel.wifi-changing: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch while the change is in progress.
bead.panel.wifi-control-unavailable: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): message under the Wi-Fi switch: the radio cannot be controlled right now.
bead.panel.wifi-off: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line of the network view: the Wi-Fi radio is off.
bead.panel.wifi-on: Status panel (network, Bluetooth, battery and sound popouts from the bar): secondary line of the network view: the Wi-Fi radio is on.
bead.panel.wifi-radio: Accessible name of the switch that turns the Wi-Fi radio on or off.
